Methods to set prices and discounts.

When you update price or discounts, some item data may be not updated. For example, if you set incorrect price or discount. Check the upload status with the [processed upload state](./work-with-products#tag/Prices-and-Discounts/paths/~1api~1v2~1history~1tasks/get) methods.

Upload statuses: - `3` — processed, no errors in items, prices and discounts were updated - `4` — canceled - `5` — processed, but some items have errors. Prices and Discounts for the other items were updated. You can get errors with the [processed upload details](./work-with-products#tag/Prices-and-Discounts/paths/~1api~1v2~1history~1goods~1task/get) method. - `6` — processed, but all items have errors. You can get errors with the [processed upload details](./work-with-products#tag/Prices-and-Discounts/paths/~1api~1v2~1history~1goods~1task/get) method too. If you set discounts with [promo calendar](./promotion#tag/promoCalendar), uploads are processing. Discount will be set at promo start. This upload has status `1`, and you can get upload state and details with the [unprocessed upload state](./work-with-products#tag/Prices-and-Discounts/paths/~1api~1v2~1buffer~1tasks/get) and [unprocessed upload details](./work-with-products#tag/Prices-and-Discounts/paths/~1api~1v2~1buffer~1goods~1task/get) methods.

You can create listings in the [Content](./api-information#tag/authorization/Token-categories) sandbox and then edit the cards prices in the Prices and Discounts sandbox.
There is no upload status 2.
